patch_list: Cash reads as 2,147,483,647 everywhere and cash purchases never deduct it. The game's OBB data file (462.6 MiB main.20251202.com.naturalmotion.csrracing.obb) must still be installed for the game to boot.

Gold reads as 268,435,455 everywhere and gold purchases never deduct it. The game's OBB data file (462.6 MiB main.20251202.com.naturalmotion.csrracing.obb) must still be installed for the game to boot.
